1508.text: Capitana Morgana raided the port of Nassau

1513.text: El Cuervo Negro was shipwrecked near Skull Rock

1519.text: Barbanegra founded a hideout on Tortuga

1524.text: The treasure of Isla del Fuego was buried by Captain Reyes

1531.text: A mutiny broke out aboard the Serpiente Dorada near Coral Bay

1537.text: Barbablanca defeated the Royal Fleet at Devil's Strait

1542.text: El Pata de Palo established a trading post in Puerto Cangrejo

1549.text: The ghost ship Ánimas was last seen near Fog Island

1556.text: Capitana Morgana signed a truce at Turtle Island

1563.text: Barbanegra's crew discovered the Cave of Whispers on Isla Sombra

1571.text: A great storm sank three galleons off Shark Reef

1578.text: El Cuervo Negro captured the merchant ship Esperanza near Bahía Perdida

1585.text: Barbablanca retired to a cottage on Turtle Island

1593.text: The legendary map of Isla del Fuego was stolen from Puerto Cangrejo

1601.text: Capitana Morgana's fleet was ambushed at Devil's Strait
